module: Aerial chase drone camera (disabled by default, icon cameraFocusOnVehicle1): floats above and behind the player's vehicle according to its (smoothed) heading, looks at it and banks in turns. An underdamped spring-damper (visible overshoot, slower rise) moves it; it follows the terrain (aware of tunnels/bridges) and keeps safeDist meters from buildings. Everything runs on dtSim (consistent in fast-forward/slow motion). Movement inputs shift the desired position (positionOffset), rotation inputs make it orbit. Returns a constructor.
notes: data.res.collisionCompatible = false: the camera collision filter does not apply to this mode.

Adjustable parameters (listParams): dist 12 m (4 to 80), height 6 m (1-40), bank (0-2), float (0.2-3, inertia), safeDist (0-5 m), fov (10-140, 55 by default). No player vehicle: the camera keeps its previous pose.
Safeguards: minimum altitude 2 m above the ground and 0.8 m below a ceiling (tunnel).
The extraction reports a global "i": it is actually the `for i = 0, 5` loop of the probe table (local variable); no real leak.

C.desc: Drone mode. Fields: camDist, height, fov, bank, floating, safeDist, positionOffset, orbitYaw, orbitPitch, pos, vel, head.

init.desc: Sets the default values and calls reset.

reset.desc: Marks the drone to be repositioned, cancels velocity, offset and orbit.

setDistance.desc: Sets the follow distance clamped to [4, 80] m.

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook: on focus gain, the drone is repositioned.

focused.desc: true if the mode takes focus

placeInit.desc: Places the drone instantly at a position and cancels its velocity.

clampAltitude.desc: Corrects the altitude to follow the vehicle: under cover stays between ground+2 m and ceiling-0.8 m; in the open climbs to fly over hills.

car.desc: center of the vehicle's bounding box

avoid.desc: Keeps the safety distance from static meshes: stays on the vehicle's side of any wall, and pushes out of any obstacle closer than safeDist (6 horizontal probes).

listParams.desc: List of settings exposed to the camera control UI / video stream (dist, height, bank, float, safeDist, fov).

returns.desc: descriptors {key, title, kind, type, value, default, min, max, step, unit}

key.desc: dist, fov, height, bank, float or safeDist

serialize.desc: Saves the mode state (distance, fov, height, bank, float, safeDist, positionOffset, orbit).

deserialize.desc: Restores the saved state and forces repositioning.

update.desc: Computes the drone pose and writes it to data.res (pos, rot, fov, targetPos).
